en.title: The Automaton of Twilight Manor
en.premise: An inexplicable locked-room murder has occurred at Twilight Manor, located on a remote, isolated island. The victim was discovered in a room completely sealed from the outside, with only a strange mechanical doll—claiming to be a 'lost artificial intelligence'—left at the scene. As the entire manor is engulfed in the clamor and madness of a festival, a brilliant detective sets out to uncover the sophisticated human trickery hidden behind the veil of the supernatural.

zh.title: 黄昏馆的自动人偶
zh.premise: 在偏远孤岛上的黄昏馆，发生了一起不可思议的密室杀人案。受害者被发现于一间与外界完全隔绝的房间内，而现场竟留下了一个自称是“迷路人工智能”的奇异机械人偶。在整个馆邸被祭典的喧嚣与疯狂所笼罩之际，名侦探将揭开隐藏在怪异现象背后的精巧人性诡计。
